hooks.name: Kiro usage log (spec task done)
hooks.description: After each spec task completes, appends 3–5 dated lines to docs/kiro-usage.md.

action.prompt:
A spec task just finished. Append a short entry to docs/kiro-usage.md (raw material for the Kiroween write-up):
- Under a heading "## YYYY-MM-DD — <short title>" for today's date (reuse today's heading if it exists; add bullets under it, never rewrite earlier entries).
- 3–5 bullet lines, plain English, past tense: what was built (spec name + task), and anything a spec, property test (counterexample found), or hook (what it blocked or flagged) caught. Name files and test names; no filler.
- If nothing was caught, say what was built only. Do not invent findings.
- Never include health data, secrets, or links to docs/internal/. Follow medical-safety.md wording.
- Edit only docs/kiro-usage.md. Do not commit.
